title: +TRANSFERABLE PROFESSIONAL AND SCIENTIFIC SKILLS
description: Examine critical interpersonal and leadership skills for working in teams. Utilize strategies for time management to balance research and academic goals. Develop critical software and presentation skills for research. Analyze scientific literature to develop independent research questions and deconstruct a peer-reviewed journal article to identify how to convey science. Use the literature search to design a solution to global challenges in human health, the environment, and energy. Develop critical skills in science communication.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: CH 220.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CH 220.
